message.content:
I need to understand the current bottom-left sidebar user/account dropdown in this InkOS Next.js app. The screenshot shows it contains: workspace info (avatar + name + email + role badge), My profile, Account settings, Studio settings, Team & members, Billing & plan, Integrations, Appearance (with submenu), Sign out.

Find:
1. The component that renders this bottom-left dropdown — likely in `components/app/sidebar/` or similar. Look for UserMenu, AccountMenu, SidebarFooter, WorkspaceSwitcher, or similar names.
2. The exact file paths with line numbers for each menu item.
3. Any separate components for the workspace/studio info header, the Appearance submenu, the Sign out handler.
4. Where this dropdown is mounted (which layout or sidebar component).
5. The icons used (lucide-react names).
6. Any permissions/role-gating logic (e.g., Studio settings only for owners).

Also find:
7. The existing top-right area in the authenticated app shell — is there a top bar / header / PageHeader component? What's currently in the top-right? Look at `app/(app)/layout.tsx` and `components/app/`.
8. Any existing user avatar / profile button at the top.

Return: file paths with line numbers, component names, the menu structure, role-gating logic, and what currently occupies top-right. Thorough report under 500 words.

2	import { cookies, headers } from 'next/headers'
3	import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/server'
4	import { resolveDynamicLabels } from '@/lib/breadcrumbs/resolve'

10	import { StudioParamSync } from '@/components/shared/StudioParamSync'
11	import { getActiveStudio, NoStudioMembershipError } from '@/lib/context/active-studio'
12	import { getActiveLocation } from '@/lib/context/active-location'
13	import { fetchUserPins } from '@/lib/pinned-items/pinned'
14	import { getMtdCommissionTotal } from '@/lib/commissions/get-mtd-summary'
15	import type { DynamicBadgeCounts } from '@/components/app/sidebar/SidebarNavGroup'
16	
17	interface AppLayoutProps {
18	  children: React.ReactNode
19	}
20	
21	export default async function AppLayout({ children }: AppLayoutProps) {
22	  const supabase = await createClient()
23	  const {
24	    data: { user },
25	  } = await supabase.auth.getUser()
26	
27	  if (!user) {
28	    redirect('/login')
29	  }
30	
31	  // S15: resolve active studio via cookie (replaces .limit(1).single() pattern)
32	  let activeStudio: Awaited<ReturnType<typeof getActiveStudio>>
33	  try {
34	    activeStudio = await getActiveStudio()
35	  } catch (err) {
36	    if (err instanceof NoStudioMembershipError) {
37	      redirect('/onboarding')
38	    }
39	    redirect('/onboarding')
40	  }
41	
42	  const { studioId, studio, role, plan, allMemberships } = activeStudio
43	
44	  // S15: resolve active location (depends on studioId — sequential, not Promise.all)
45	  const activeLocation = await getActiveLocation(studioId, role)
46	
47	  // Fetch user profile + dynamic badge counts in parallel
48	  const sevenDaysAgo = new Date(Date.now() - 7 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000).toISOString()
49	  const oneDayAgo = new Date(Date.now() - 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000).toISOString()
50	  const todayStart = new Date()
51	  todayStart.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0)
52	  const todayEnd = new Date()
53	  todayEnd.setHours(23, 59, 59, 999)
54	
55	  // S22: resolve artist record id for artist-role MTD filter
56	  // artists.profile_id links to profiles.id (= user.id)
57	  let artistIdForMtd: string | undefined
58	  if (role === 'artist') {
59	    const { data: artistRow } = await supabase
60	      .from('artists')
61	      .select('id')
62	      .eq('profile_id', user.id)
63	      .eq('studio_id', studioId)
64	      .maybeSingle()
65	    artistIdForMtd = artistRow?.id
66	  }
67	
68	  const [
69	    profileResult,
70	    inboxPendingRes,
71	    inboxConsentRes,
72	    inboxWaitlistRes,
73	    calendarTodayRes,
74	    clientsTotalRes,
75	    inventoryLowRes,
76	    inboxUnreadConvsRes,
77	  ] = await Promise.all([
78	    supabase
79	      .from('profiles')
80	      .select('full_name, avatar_url')
81	      .eq('id', user.id)
82	      .single(),
83	    // Inbox: pending bookings (status='pending')
84	    supabase
85	      .from('bookings')
86	      .select('id', { count: 'exact', head: true })
87	      .eq('studio_id', studioId)
88	      .eq('status', 'pending'),
89	    // Inbox: consent submissions in last 7d (no reviewed_at field — approximate with signed_at)
90	    supabase
91	      .from('consent_form_submissions')
92	      .select('id', { count: 'exact', head: true })
93	      .eq('studio_id', studioId)
94	      .gte('created_at', sevenDaysAgo)
95	      .is('soft_deleted_at', null),
96	    // Inbox: waitlist entries in last 24h
97	    supabase
98	      .from('waitlist_entries')
99	      .select('id', { count: 'exact', head: true })
100	      .eq('studio_id', studioId)
101	      .gte('created_at', oneDayAgo),
102	    // Calendar: bookings scheduled today
103	    supabase
104	      .from('bookings')
105	      .select('id', { count: 'exact', head: true })
106	      .eq('studio_id', studioId)
107	      .gte('scheduled_at', todayStart.toISOString())
108	      .lte('scheduled_at', todayEnd.toISOString()),
109	    // Clients: total for studio
110	    supabase
111	      .from('clients')
112	      .select('id', { count: 'exact', head: true })
113	      .eq('studio_id', studioId),
114	    // Inventory: items at zero stock (proxy for low-stock alert)
115	    supabase
116	      .from('inventory_items')
117	      .select('id', { count: 'exact', head: true })
118	      .eq('studio_id', studioId)
119	      .eq('is_active', true)
120	      .eq('current_stock', 0),
121	
122	    // Inbox: unread conversation count
123	    supabase
124	      .from('conversations')
125	      .select('id', { count: 'exact', head: true })
126	      .eq('studio_id', studioId)
127	      .is('archived_at', null)
128	      .gt('unread_count', 0),
129	  ])
130	
131	  // S22: Pins + MTD commissions + dynamic breadcrumb labels — parallel after main badge fetches
132	  const canViewCommissions = role === 'owner' || role === 'admin' || role === 'artist'
133	  const currentPathname = (await headers()).get('x-pathname') ?? '/dashboard'
134	  const [pinnedItems, mtdResult, dynamicLabels] = await Promise.all([
135	    fetchUserPins(user.id, studioId),
136	    canViewCommissions
137	      ? getMtdCommissionTotal(supabase, studioId, artistIdForMtd ? { artistId: artistIdForMtd } : undefined)
138	      : Promise.resolve(null),
139	    resolveDynamicLabels(supabase, currentPathname),
140	  ])
141	  const mtdCommissionCents = mtdResult?.totalCents ?? null
142	
143	  // Permissions
144	  const permissionsSet =
145	    studioId && user ? await getUserPermissions(studioId, user.id) : new Set<string>()
146	  const permissionKeys = [...permissionsSet]
147	
148	  // Sidebar state from cookie
149	  const cookieStore = await cookies()
150	  const sidebarOpen = cookieStore.get('sidebar_state')?.value !== 'false'
151	
152	  const profile = profileResult.data
153	  const userName = profile?.full_name ?? user.email?.split('@')[0] ?? 'You'
154	  const userEmail = user.email ?? ''
155	  const userAvatarUrl = profile?.avatar_url ?? null
156	  const studioName = studio.name
157	  const studioLogoUrl = studio.logo_url ?? null
158	  const studioSlug = studio.slug
159	
160	  // Compute dynamic badge counts (graceful: null count → 0)
161	  const inboxCount =
162	    (inboxPendingRes.count ?? 0) +
163	    (inboxConsentRes.count ?? 0) +
164	    (inboxWaitlistRes.count ?? 0) +
165	    (inboxUnreadConvsRes.count ?? 0)
166	
167	  const dynamicBadges: DynamicBadgeCounts = {
168	    inbox: inboxCount,
169	    calendar: calendarTodayRes.count ?? 0,
170	    clients: clientsTotalRes.count ?? 0,
171	    inventory: inventoryLowRes.count ?? 0,
172	  }
173	
174	  return (
175	    <PermissionsProvider permissionKeys={permissionKeys}>
176	      {/* S15: StudioParamSync handles ?studio=X deep links — renders null */}
177	      <StudioParamSync currentStudioId={studioId} />
178	      <SidebarProvider defaultOpen={sidebarOpen} className="h-svh">
179	        <AppSidebar
180	          locationCount={activeLocation.allLocations.length}
181	          plan={plan}
182	          studioName={studioName}
183	          studioLogoUrl={studioLogoUrl}
184	          studioSlug={studioSlug}
185	          role={role}
186	          permissionKeys={permissionKeys}
187	          dynamicBadges={dynamicBadges}
188	          allMemberships={allMemberships}
189	          currentStudioId={studioId}
190	          userName={userName}
191	          userEmail={userEmail}
192	          userAvatarUrl={userAvatarUrl}
193	          pinnedItems={pinnedItems}
194	        />
195	        <AppHeader
196	          studioName={studioName}
197	          studioSlug={studioSlug}
198	          userName={userName}
199	          userEmail={userEmail}
200	          userAvatarUrl={userAvatarUrl}
201	          role={role}
202	          plan={plan}
203	          allMemberships={allMemberships}
204	          currentStudioId={studioId}
205	          currentLocationId={activeLocation.locationId}
206	          allLocations={activeLocation.allLocations}
207	          permissionKeys={permissionKeys}
208	          dynamicBadges={dynamicBadges}
209	          mtdCommissionCents={mtdCommissionCents}
210	          canViewCommissions={canViewCommissions}
211	          dynamicLabels={dynamicLabels}
212	        >
213	          {children}
214	        </AppHeader>
215	      </SidebarProvider>
216	    </PermissionsProvider>
217	  )
218	}
